reply.emotion: busy and purposeful, heading out to get what is needed for the day
notes: Use comprar for any everyday transaction where money is exchanged for goods or services.

senses.definition: Adquirir algo a cambio de dinero.

examples.text: Voy a comprar fruta fresca en el mercado.
examples.translation: I am going to buy fresh fruit at the market.
examples.emotion: looking forward to a good meal, practical and upbeat

senses.definition: Creer o aceptar una idea o un argumento de alguien.

examples.text: No voy a comprar esa excusa otra vez.
examples.translation: I am not going to buy that excuse again.
examples.emotion: fed up and firm, tired of hearing the same story
